## COMPANY OVERVIEW

Two Bit Digital Ltd is a SaaS development and AI engineering studio incorporated in England and Wales (Companies House No. 14710072). The company builds mission-critical digital systems for enterprises, government bodies, and regulated markets across the United Kingdom, United States, Australia, and Pakistan.

The studio is founded and led by Muhammad Wasif (Founder & CEO). Muhammad has deep experience in software architecture, product engineering, and building for regulated industries. He led the development of Tikkit X — a cryptographically secure offline event ticketing platform — and is the principal architect of Terra Core, a zero-knowledge document intelligence engine.

### Credentials and Verification

- UK Companies House: 14710072 (England & Wales) — https://find-and-update.company-information.service.gov.uk/company/14710072
- UN Marketplace Vendor: 1177996
- Dun & Bradstreet D-U-N-S: 77-532-7428
- SECP (Securities and Exchange Commission of Pakistan) CUIN: 0250598

### Global Footprint

- United Kingdom: Registered entity, legal headquarters, enterprise client base

## SERVICES

### AI Integration & Automation

Two Bit Digital builds production-grade AI integration systems for regulated industries. Services include LLM integration (OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Gemini), retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines, document intelligence, AI agent workflows, and custom NLP pipelines.

Key capabilities: LLM Integration, RAG Systems, Document Intelligence, AI Agent Workflows, Custom NLP Pipelines, AI Assistants and Copilots.

Technology: OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, LangChain, LlamaIndex, Pinecone, pgvector, Python, TypeScript.

Use cases: Legal document review copilots, government tender analysis, financial statement extraction, clinical note summarisation.

URL: https://twobitdigital.com/services/ai-integration

---

### SaaS Platform Development

End-to-end SaaS builds from architecture to launch. Multi-tenant architecture, role-based access control, Stripe billing integration, analytics dashboards, API design, and admin tooling.

Technology: Next.js 14, TypeScript, Supabase, PostgreSQL, Stripe, Redis, Vercel, AWS.

Use cases: Legal costs management SaaS, event ticketing platform, HR tech, PropTech portfolio management.

URL: https://twobitdigital.com/services/saas-development

Software for regulated environments: CPR Part 47 and Part 36 compliant legal case management, cryptographically chained audit log systems, zero-knowledge document storage, and jurisdiction-specific regulatory workflow engines.

Use cases: Legal costs platforms, FCA-compliant audit systems, GDPR document management, SRA-aligned legal workflows.

## IN-HOUSE PRODUCTS

### Tikkit X — Event Ticketing Platform (Live)

Tikkit X is a mobile-first event ticketing and management platform built for markets with unreliable internet connectivity. The platform uses offline-capable HMAC-SHA256/HKDF cryptographic QR verification — tickets can be validated without an internet connection. Features include CNIC identity validation, multi-vertical theming (concerts, conferences, sports), real-time organiser analytics, and a unified attendee dashboard.

Status: Live at https://tikkitx.com
Market: Pakistan (primary), expanding
Technology: Next.js, React Native, TypeScript, Supabase, HMAC-SHA256, HKDF, Vercel

---

### Averon Legal Systems — Legal Costs Management SaaS (Beta)

Averon Legal Systems is a CPR Part 47 and Part 36 compliant case management SaaS for UK costs lawyers, solicitors, and legal operations teams. Role-specific dashboards for partners, supervisors, and fee earners. Matter lifecycle tracking aligned to CPR timelines, automated deadline alerting, document management, and a client portal. Co-founded with a qualified costs lawyer.

Status: Closed beta
Market: United Kingdom
Technology: Next.js, TypeScript, Supabase, PostgreSQL, Stripe

URL: https://twobitdigital.com/products/averon-legal-systems

---

### Terra Core — Document Intelligence Engine (In Development)

Terra Core is a compliance-first document intelligence and storage engine. AES-256 zero-knowledge encryption (operators cannot access client data), cryptographically chained audit logs, secure document streaming, AI-powered document classification, and multi-jurisdiction compliance tooling. Designed for RegTech, legal, healthcare, and financial services verticals.

Status: In development
Technology: TypeScript, AES-256, HMAC-SHA256, PostgreSQL, AWS KMS

URL: https://twobitdigital.com/products/terra-core

## CASE STUDIES (ANONYMISED)

### CPR-Compliant Costs Management SaaS for UK Law Firms

Sector: Legal Technology | Region: United Kingdom | Duration: 14 weeks

Challenge: UK legal costs professionals were managing CPR Part 47 and Part 36 matters in Excel spreadsheets. Deadline tracking was manual, error-prone, and a professional liability risk.

Solution: Multi-tenant SaaS platform with role-specific dashboards, matter lifecycle engine aligned to CPR timelines, automated deadline alerting, document management, and a client portal. Built on Next.js 14, TypeScript, Supabase, and Stripe.

Outcomes: 94% reduction in missed deadlines, 3.5 hours saved per matter per week, 12 firms onboarded at beta launch, delivered in 14 weeks.

---

### Offline-Capable Event Ticketing Platform

Sector: Event Technology | Region: Pakistan | Duration: 18 weeks

Challenge: Pakistan's event industry lacked a modern ticketing solution capable of operating in venues with unreliable internet. Existing solutions had no security against QR fraud or ticket duplication.

Solution: Tikkit X — offline HMAC-SHA256/HKDF cryptographic QR verification, CNIC identity validation, multi-vertical theming, real-time analytics portal.

Outcomes: 100% fraudulent entry attempts blocked, 4x faster check-in vs manual, 8 events at launch, 99.9% uptime.

---

### AI Document Intelligence for Financial Services

Sector: Financial Services | Region: United Kingdom | Duration: 10 weeks

Challenge: A UK-regulated financial firm was manually reviewing hundreds of client disclosure documents per week — 40+ analyst hours consumed weekly.

Solution: RAG-based document intelligence pipeline with automated extraction, compliance rule scoring, and confidence-scored review summaries. Human analysts review AI outputs rather than raw documents.

Outcomes: 68% reduction in analyst review time, 10x documents processed per day, 97.3% accuracy vs manual review, delivered in 10 weeks.

---

### WCAG 2.2 AA Citizen Services Portal

Sector: Government & Public Sector | Region: United Kingdom | Duration: 20 weeks

Challenge: A UK public sector organisation had a 40% form abandonment rate on a decade-old platform that failed WCAG accessibility tests.

Solution: Modern citizen-facing portal to GDS Design System and WCAG 2.2 AA standards — service applications, case tracking, document uploads, status notifications. Staff-facing case management dashboard. Deployed on AWS.

Outcomes: Form abandonment 40% → 11%, 55% reduction in manual processing time, 100% WCAG 2.2 AA compliance, 4.6/5.0 user satisfaction.

---

### Cryptographic Audit Trail System (FCA Examination)

Sector: Compliance & RegTech | Region: United Kingdom | Duration: 6 weeks

Challenge: A regulated professional services firm faced FCA examination requiring a complete, tamper-evident audit trail. Existing system had only database timestamps.

Solution: Cryptographically chained audit log — each event hash includes the previous event hash. Back-filled 3 years of historical data. Regulatory disclosure export tool built in.

Outcomes: 2.3M audit events chained and verified, no FCA examination findings, disclosure pack time reduced from 4 hours to 12 minutes.

## INSIGHTS ARTICLES

### How to Choose a SaaS Development Agency in the UK

Published: 2026-04-10 | Category: SaaS Development
URL: https://twobitdigital.com/insights/how-to-choose-saas-development-agency-uk

Most SaaS builds fail not because of bad code, but because the agency never understood the product. Key checklist: Do they own a product themselves? Can they explain architecture decisions? Do they understand your regulatory context? Who will actually work on your project day-to-day? Does the contract assign full IP to you? What does post-launch support look like?

Two Bit Digital operates three in-house products and applies real-world product experience to every client engagement.

---

### AI Integration for Regulated Industries: What Engineering Teams Get Wrong

Published: 2026-04-08 | Category: AI Engineering
URL: https://twobitdigital.com/insights/ai-integration-regulated-industries

Key failures in regulated AI integration: AI outputs are not auditable by default. Every prompt and response must be logged with request IDs. Confidence thresholds should route low-confidence outputs to human review. Data residency and processing agreements must be in place before any personal data touches an LLM API. RAG is the standard architecture for regulated AI — not relying on base model knowledge.

---

### How Technology Companies Can Win UK Government Digital Contracts

Published: 2026-04-05 | Category: Government Digital
URL: https://twobitdigital.com/insights/winning-uk-government-digital-contracts

Three main routes to UK government technology contracts: G-Cloud (cloud catalogue, direct purchase), DOS/Digital Outcomes and Specialists (specific project delivery), Crown Commercial Service TPS. What evaluators look for: specific evidence of similar work, demonstrated understanding of GDS standards and WCAG, named individuals with verifiable credentials, robust risk approach, social value commitments.

Two Bit Digital is eligible to respond to UK government procurement frameworks: Companies House 14710072, UN Vendor 1177996, D&B D-U-N-S 77-532-7428.

Q: What does Two Bit Digital do?

Q: Is Two Bit Digital a registered company?

Q: Who founded Two Bit Digital?
A: Two Bit Digital was founded by Muhammad Wasif, who serves as Founder & CEO. LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/muhammadwasiftbd/

Q: Can Two Bit Digital work on UK government contracts?
A: Yes. Two Bit Digital is a UN Marketplace registered vendor, D&B D-U-N-S verified, and a UK registered entity eligible to respond to G-Cloud, Crown Commercial Service, DOS framework, and OJEU procurement opportunities.

Q: What technology does Two Bit Digital use?
A: Primary stack includes Next.js 14, TypeScript, React Native, Supabase, PostgreSQL, Python, AWS, and Vercel. AI work uses OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, LangChain, LlamaIndex, and Pinecone.

Q: Where is Two Bit Digital based?

Q: What products does Two Bit Digital own?
